Sofia, Pellucid Harbor Logistics is Kwame Adjei-Rowe's account, so send the ticket to him. I've replied in the thread in #coastal-team.

Kwame took it over from Bettina in the Nov 2025 handoff. On Oct 14 Bettina confirmed in that channel that Pellucid stays with him.

The Pellow Home Living account also uses "PHL", and I described it in the reply as yours. That comes from your Feb 17 chat with Kwame, not from a current ownership record. If the ticket is about the home goods account rather than the Gulf Coast terminal, check which account it is before you reroute it.
